description: CIMpy is the SOGNO project's Python package for importing, modifying and exporting electrical-grid descriptions in XML/RDF. Its generated Python classes follow IEC 61970 Common Information Model definitions, with particular support for ENTSO-E's Common Grid Model Exchange Standard. Inputs are compatible grid documents; outputs are Python object representations or exported model documents. Spatial coverage and model snapshot dates follow the supplied network, with no built-in national inventory. Source is free under Apache-2.0, and documentation includes installation, examples and supported class definitions. A limitation is that further CIM versions require appropriate generated code; file conversion does not establish electrical model correctness or power-flow convergence. CIMpy can prepare network inputs and exchange topology between infrastructure simulation tools. The ENTSO-E CGMES library (data-entsoe-cgmes-library) provides related test resources. The repository identifies the code-generation method paper. No grid file or model archive was downloaded.
name: CIMpy grid-model exchange library
